text:
lee: starting rollout release/2026-03-25. change window active. canary -> route: generate-text (us-west). start 7%. primary metrics: p95, 5xx, retry count.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary start: release/2026-03-25 -> nodeset-canary-07. traffic=7%. preflight ok.
nina: copied SLO board -> https://graf.redwood/generate-text/slo. baseline p95=170ms. i'll keep a snapshot.
ash: watching 5xx and broker retry counts. will flag if retries spike.

alerts-bot: Alert: generate-text 5xx rate > 0.4% for 2m. severity=warn. link: https://alerts.redwood/10021

lee: hold ramp. tagging oncall. any infra changes?
nina: no code diffs. seeing higher downstream queue latency hitting rpc-client timeouts around 250ms for specific instances.

ash: traces show retry loop triggers when rpc-client returns 504s, appears to be ephemeral connection resets.

lee: quick mitigation plan: (1) pin canary nodeset to runtime=v1.23.1 (previous stable), (2) reduce route concurrency from 48 to 24, (3) enable short retry-backoff at the proxy layer. @deploy-bot apply pins and flags.
deploy-bot: Applying: pin nodeset-canary-07 -> runtime=v1.23.1; set feature flag generate_concurrency=24 for nodeset-canary-07; set proxy_retry_backoff=short for nodeset-canary-07.

nina: after changes p95 down to ~200ms, 5xx at 0.12% and retries back to baseline.

alerts-bot: Alert resolved: generate-text 5xx back below threshold. closing 10021.

lee: keep canary at 7% for 10 more minutes then ramp to 30% if stable. if 5xx > 0.4% after ramp -> immediate rollback to release/2026-03-10 and notify SRE.

ash: filing follow-up ticket OPS-1310 to investigate rpc-client connection stability.

lee: noted. will add a short note to release notes about temporary runtime pin and concurrency change. closing watch after 30m if stable.
